The color Doppler demonstrates a large central mitral regurgitant jet into the dilated left atrium (LA labeled), and the grayscale image shows thickened, calcified mitral leaflets with diastolic doming (hockey-stick deformity) — the textbook chronic rheumatic mitral valve phenotype — matching the disease-focused article title ('Rheumatic Mitral Valve Disease'). Commissural fusion and fish-mouth orifice are not explicitly captioned, so they are not tagged. The article title ('in a Young Adult') supports adult age; no ethnicity or skin is visible. LV = left ventricle; RA = right artery; RV = right ventricle.
in_text_mentions: She underwent transesophageal echocardiogram (TEE) before planned cardioversion. Progressive MS was confirmed, with a mean gradient of 5 mm Hg (heart rate: 107 beats/min) and mitral valve area of 1.5 cm2. Due to the thrombus, cardioversion was deferred.
